scheme_name: Mai Ramabai Ambedakar Saat Phera Samuh Lagna Yojana
other_conditions: Remarriage is not eligible for the scheme
Applications for assistance must be made within two years of the marriage
Benefit is available only to the beneficiary girl participating in the group marriage
Assistance is available to girls from Kunwar Bai Nu Mameru Yojana
Marriage registration certificate must be submitted to avail the benefits
The organizing institution must apply within two years from the date of marriage
The bride must produce a certified copy of the caste certificate obtained from the competent authority
benefits_summary: Couples receive ₹12,000 per marriage, and organizers receive ₹3,000 per couple up to a maximum of ₹75,000.
documents_required: Proof of age of bride and groom
